        Round(line,999)

        local avatarHolder = New("Frame", {
            BackgroundColor3=Theme.Panel3,
            BackgroundTransparency=.40,
            BorderSizePixel=0,
            Position=UDim2.fromOffset(13,18),
            Size=UDim2.fromOffset(64,64),
            ZIndex=17,
            Parent=row,
        })
        Round(avatarHolder,999)
        Stroke(avatarHolder,accentColor,.56,1)

        local avatar = New("ImageLabel", {
            BackgroundTransparency=1,
            Position=UDim2.fromOffset(2,2),
            Size=UDim2.new(1,-4,1,-4),
            Image="",
            ScaleType=Enum.ScaleType.Crop,
            ZIndex=18,
            Parent=avatarHolder,
        })
        Round(avatar,999)

        task.spawn(function()
            local image = getPlayerHeadshot(player.UserId)
            if avatar.Parent then
                avatar.Image = image
            end
        end)

        New("TextLabel", {
            BackgroundTransparency=1,
            Position=UDim2.fromOffset(93,15),
            Size=UDim2.new(1,-106,0,16),
            Font=Enum.Font.GothamBold,
            Text=opts.Kicker or "PLAYER",
            TextColor3=accentColor,
            TextSize=9,
            TextXAlignment=Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
            ZIndex=17,
            Parent=row,
        })

        local displayName = New("TextLabel", {
            BackgroundTransparency=1,
            Position=UDim2.fromOffset(93,33),
            Size=UDim2.new(1,-106,0,24),
            Font=Enum.Font.GothamMedium,
            Text=opts.DisplayName or player.DisplayName,
            TextColor3=Theme.Text,
            TextSize=14,
            TextXAlignment=Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
            TextTruncate=Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd,
            ZIndex=17,
            Parent=row,
        })

        local username = New("TextLabel", {
            BackgroundTransparency=1,
            Position=UDim2.fromOffset(93,57),
            Size=UDim2.new(1,-106,0,18),
            Font=Enum.Font.Gotham,
            Text=opts.Username or ("@" .. player.Name),
            TextColor3=Theme.TextSoft,
            TextSize=10,
            TextXAlignment=Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
            TextTruncate=Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd,
            ZIndex=17,
            Parent=row,
        })

        local note = New("TextLabel", {
            BackgroundTransparency=1,
            Position=UDim2.fromOffset(93,77),
            Size=UDim2.new(1,-106,0,17),
            Font=Enum.Font.GothamMedium,
            Text=opts.Note or "Serenity user",
            TextColor3=accentColor,
            TextSize=9,
            TextXAlignment=Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
            TextTruncate=Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd,
            ZIndex=17,
            Parent=row,
        })

        return {
            Row=row,
            Avatar=avatar,
            DisplayName=displayName,
            Username=username,
            Note=note,
        }
    end

    function Window:CopyDiscordInvite()
        local ok = copyText(discordInvite)

        if ok then
            Window:Notify(
                "Discord",
                "Invite copied to your clipboard.",
                true
            )
        else
            Window:Notify(
                "Discord",
                "Clipboard access is not available in this environment.",
                false
            )
        end

        return ok
    end

    function Window:CommunityCard(parent, opts)
        opts = opts or {}

        local row = baseRow(parent, opts.Height or 118)
        local color = opts.Accent or Theme.Lavender

        local line = New("Frame", {
            BackgroundColor3=color,
            BorderSizePixel=0,
            Position=UDim2.fromOffset(0,0),
            Size=UDim2.new(0,3,1,0),
            ZIndex=17,
            Parent=row,
        })
        Round(line,999)

        New("TextLabel", {
            BackgroundTransparency=1,
            Position=UDim2.fromOffset(14,10),
            Size=UDim2.new(1,-28,0,18),
            Font=Enum.Font.GothamBold,
            Text=opts.Kicker or "COMMUNITY",
            TextColor3=color,
            TextSize=9,
            TextXAlignment=Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
            ZIndex=17,
            Parent=row,
        })

        New("TextLabel", {
            BackgroundTransparency=1,
            Position=UDim2.fromOffset(14,30),
            Size=UDim2.new(1,-28,0,27),
            Font=Enum.Font.GothamBold,
            Text=opts.Title or "Join Discord for more updates",
            TextColor3=Theme.Text,
            TextSize=15,
            TextXAlignment=Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
            TextTruncate=Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd,
            ZIndex=17,
            Parent=row,
        })

        New("TextLabel", {
            BackgroundTransparency=1,
            Position=UDim2.fromOffset(14,57),
            Size=UDim2.new(1,-145,0,45),
            Font=Enum.Font.Gotham,
            Text=opts.Description or "Get update notes, fixes, supported-game news and Serenity Hub announcements.",
            TextColor3=Theme.TextSoft,
            TextSize=10,
            TextWrapped=true,
            TextXAlignment=Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
            TextYAlignment=Enum.TextYAlignment.Top,
            ZIndex=17,
            Parent=row,
        })

        local copy = New("Frame", {
            AnchorPoint=Vector2.new(1,1),
            Position=UDim2.new(1,-12,1,-12),
            Size=UDim2.fromOffset(120,34),
            BackgroundColor3=Theme.Panel3,
            BackgroundTransparency=.48,
            ZIndex=17,
            Parent=row,
        })
        Round(copy,10)
        Stroke(copy,color,.64,1)

        local label = New("TextLabel", {
            BackgroundTransparency=1,
            Size=UDim2.fromScale(1,1),
            Font=Enum.Font.GothamMedium,
            Text=opts.ButtonText or "Copy Discord Invite",
            TextColor3=Theme.Text,
            TextSize=9,
            ZIndex=18,
            Parent=copy,
        })

        local hit = Overlay(copy,function()
            Window:CopyDiscordInvite()
        end)

        hit.MouseEnter:Connect(function()
            Tween(copy,.12,{BackgroundTransparency=.30})
            Tween(label,.12,{TextColor3=color})
        end)

        hit.MouseLeave:Connect(function()
            Tween(copy,.12,{BackgroundTransparency=.48})
            Tween(label,.12,{TextColor3=Theme.Text})
        end)

        return row
    end

    --------------------------------------------------------------------
    -- EXISTING V11 CONTROL API (UNCHANGED)
    --------------------------------------------------------------------


    --------------------------------------------------------------------
    -- V13 COMPONENT SYSTEM
    --
    -- New games should prefer these semantic controls:
    --   Group       -> always-visible category/subcategory
    --   Action      -> one-click command, no enabled state
    --   Switch      -> enabled / disabled feature
    --   Select      -> choose exactly one value
    --   MultiSelect -> choose zero, one, or many values
    --   Input       -> free-form or numeric input
    --
    -- Legacy V11/V12 Toggle/Button/Dropdown/Slider remain below so
    -- existing games are not forced to migrate immediately.
    --------------------------------------------------------------------

    local function resolveAccent(value)
        if typeof(value) == "Color3" then
            return value
        end

        value = string.lower(tostring(value or "cyan"))

        if value == "mint" then
            return Theme.Mint
        elseif value == "lavender" or value == "purple" then
            return Theme.Lavender
        elseif value == "warning" or value == "gold" then
            return Theme.Warning
        elseif value == "danger" or value == "red" then
            return Theme.Danger
        end

        return Theme.Cyan
    end

    local function copyArray(source)
        local result = {}
        for _, value in ipairs(source or {}) do
            result[#result + 1] = value
        end
        return result
    end

    local function makeSet(source)
        local result = {}

        if type(source) == "table" then
            if #source > 0 then
                for _, value in ipairs(source) do
                    result[tostring(value)] = true
                end
            else
                for key, enabled in pairs(source) do
                    if enabled then
                        result[tostring(key)] = true
                    end
                end
            end
        end

        return result
    end

    local function selectedList(values, selected)
        local result = {}

        for _, value in ipairs(values or {}) do
            if selected[tostring(value)] then
                result[#result + 1] = value
            end
        end

        return result
    end

    local function summarizeSelection(values, selected, opts)
        opts = opts or {}

        local chosen = selectedList(values, selected)
        local count = #chosen

        if count == 0 then
            if opts.EmptyMeansAll then
                return opts.EmptyText or "All"
            end
            return opts.EmptyText or "Select Options"
        end

        if count == #values and opts.ShowAllWhenEverythingSelected ~= false then
            return opts.AllText or "All"
        end

        local maxCharacters = tonumber(opts.SummaryCharacters) or 30
        local parts = {}
        local length = 0

        for index, value in ipairs(chosen) do
            local piece = tostring(value)
            local additional = #piece + (#parts > 0 and 2 or 0)

            if #parts > 0 and (length + additional) > maxCharacters then
                local remaining = count - (#parts)
                if remaining > 0 then
                    parts[#parts + 1] = "+" .. tostring(remaining)
                end
                break
            end

            parts[#parts + 1] = piece
            length += additional
        end

        return table.concat(parts, ", ")
    end

    local function closeOtherPicker(item)
        if Window._OpenPicker and Window._OpenPicker ~= item then
            local old = Window._OpenPicker
            if type(old.Close) == "function" then
                old:Close()
            end
        end
    end

    function Window:Group(parent, title, description, options)
        options = options or {}
        controlOrder += 1

        local accent = resolveAccent(options.Accent)

        local group = New("Frame", {
            LayoutOrder = controlOrder,
            BackgroundColor3 = Theme.Panel,
            BackgroundTransparency = .78,
            BorderSizePixel = 0,
            Size = UDim2.new(1,0,0,0),
            AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y,
            ZIndex = 16,
            Parent = parent,
        })
        Round(group,13)
        Stroke(group,Theme.StrokeSoft,.80,1)
        Glass(group,.64,.88)

        local headerHeight = description and description ~= "" and 55 or 42

        local header = New("Frame", {
            BackgroundTransparency = 1,
            Size = UDim2.new(1,0,0,headerHeight),
            LayoutOrder = 1,
            ZIndex = 17,
            Parent = group,
        })

        -- Decorative accent belongs inside the header so the group's
        -- UIListLayout never treats it as another content row.
        local accentBar = New("Frame", {
            BackgroundColor3 = accent,
            BackgroundTransparency = .08,
            BorderSizePixel = 0,
            Position = UDim2.fromOffset(0,8),
            Size = UDim2.new(0,3,0,math.max(22,headerHeight - 16)),
            ZIndex = 18,
            Parent = header,
        })
        Round(accentBar,999)

        New("TextLabel", {
            BackgroundTransparency = 1,
            Position = UDim2.fromOffset(14,8),
            Size = UDim2.new(1,-28,0,22),
            Font = Enum.Font.GothamMedium,
            Text = tostring(title or ""),
            TextColor3 = Theme.Text,
            TextSize = 13,
            TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
            ZIndex = 18,
            Parent = header,
        })

        if description and description ~= "" then
            New("TextLabel", {
                BackgroundTransparency = 1,
                Position = UDim2.fromOffset(14,29),
                Size = UDim2.new(1,-28,0,18),
                Font = Enum.Font.Gotham,
                Text = tostring(description),
                TextColor3 = Theme.TextDim,
                TextSize = 9,
                TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
                TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd,
                ZIndex = 18,
                Parent = header,
            })
        end

        local contentFrame = New("Frame", {
            BackgroundTransparency = 1,
            Size = UDim2.new(1,-18,0,0),
            AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y,
            LayoutOrder = 2,
            ZIndex = 17,
            Parent = group,
        })

        New("UIPadding", {
            PaddingLeft = UDim.new(0,9),
            PaddingRight = UDim.new(0,9),
            PaddingBottom = UDim.new(0,9),
            Parent = contentFrame,
        })

        New("UIListLayout", {
            Padding = UDim.new(0,7),
            SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder,
            Parent = contentFrame,
        })

        New("UIListLayout", {
            Padding = UDim.new(0,0),
            SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder,
            Parent = group,
        })

        return contentFrame, group
    end

    function Window:Action(parent, title, description, callback, options)
        options = options or {}
